entries.title: Job 19:1
segments: And Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 19:2
segments: How long will you torment my soul and break me in pieces with words?

entries.title: Job 19:3
segments: [And] this, ten times you have blamed me; you are not ashamed that you have wronged me.

entries.title: Job 19:4
segments: And [if] indeed I have erred, my error remains with me.

entries.title: Job 19:5
segments: If indeed you magnify yourself against me, and plead against me my misery,

entries.title: Job 19:6
segments: know now that God has overthrown me, and His net has closed on me.

entries.title: Job 19:7
segments: Behold, I cry out, Violence! And I am not answered. I cry aloud, but there is no justice.

entries.title: Job 19:8
segments: He has fenced up my way so that I cannot pass, and He has set darkness in my paths.

entries.title: Job 19:9
segments: He has stripped me of my glory, and has taken the crown from my head.

entries.title: Job 19:10
segments: He has broken me on every side, and I am gone, and He has uprooted my hope like a tree.

entries.title: Job 19:11
segments: He has also kindled His wrath against me, and to Himself He counts me as His enemy.

entries.title: Job 19:12
segments: His troops come together and raise up their way against me, and camp around my tent.

entries.title: Job 19:13
segments: He has put my brothers far from me, and my friends have truly turned away from me.

entries.title: Job 19:14
segments: My people have fallen away, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

entries.title: Job 19:15
segments: Those who dwell in my house, and my slave-girls, count me as a stranger; I am a foreigner in their sight.

entries.title: Job 19:16
segments: I called my servant, and he gave no answer; I must beg him with my mouth.

entries.title: Job 19:17
segments: My breath is hated by my wife, and I must beg to the sons of my [mother's] womb.

entries.title: Job 19:18
segments: Even young children despise me; I arise, and they speak against me.

entries.title: Job 19:19
segments: All the men of my counsel detest me, even this one I loved has turned against me.

entries.title: Job 19:20
segments: My bone clings to my skin and to my flesh, and I have escaped with the skin of my teeth.

entries.title: Job 19:21
segments: Have pity on me! Have pity on me, my friends! For the hand of God has touched me.

entries.title: Job 19:22
segments: Why do you, like God, persecute me and are not satisfied with my flesh?

entries.title: Job 19:23
segments: Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were engraved in a book!

entries.title: Job 19:24
segments: [Oh that] they were cut with an iron pen and lead in the rock forever!

entries.title: Job 19:25
segments: For I know [that] my Redeemer lives, and He shall rise on the earth at the last;

entries.title: Job 19:26
segments: and even after they corrupt my skin, yet this: in my flesh I shall see God,

entries.title: Job 19:27
segments: whom I shall see for myself, and my eyes shall behold, and not a stranger's; [though] My heart be exhausted in my bosom.

entries.title: Job 19:28
segments: For you ought to say, Why do we persecute him, since the root of the matter is found in me?

entries.title: Job 19:29
segments: Fear for yourselves because of the sword; for wrath [brings] the punishments of the sword, so that you may know [there is] a judgment.
